title: fix(macos): keep Quick Chat model and speed choices current
body:
Related: #136257, #144762.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Quick Chat retained stale model choices after a catalog update and did not expose the published Fast setting.

## Why This Change Was Made

Quick Chat consumes the shared catalog and Fast-state projections. Settings changes use the existing session route and queue, then reload canonical state. Catalog updates refresh the open picker while preserving its draft and rejecting late results from an older presentation.

## User Impact

Refused models show guidance and cannot be selected; unknown availability remains selectable. Published effort and speed choices are available, and settings settle before sending.

Consumers: Quick Chat model and speed controls use shared session catalog facts.

## Evidence

A connected real-Gateway test reproduced the stale picker and passed after the fix. Native validation passed two UI cases, 83 native cases and 11 projection tests. Captures were inspected, but clipping limits prevent a claim about expanded-menu visual quality. Shortcut proof invoked its registered callback; it did not use a physical key event.
